title: RASC midpoint: code, data and verification for secular modulation and long-time accuracy
description:
Reproducibility artifact for Renormalized asymptotic successive corrections for implicit midpoint: secular modulation and long-time accuracy.

Includes immutable recorded numerical data, residual acceptance certificates, complete saved states and second-corrector snapshots, independent reference integrations, scientific source code and exact/numerical regression tests. It supports fixed-time reconstruction checks and finite-window long-time experiments; it does not certify a general nonlinear PDE stability theorem. The manuscript and its LaTeX sources are intentionally excluded.

Software: MIT. Original data, documentation and figures: CC BY 4.0 (see DATA_LICENSE). This RASC artifact is separate from the previously archived ASC midpoint artifact, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23048130. Version metadata is explicitly 1.0.0 in both this file and CITATION.cff. No self-DOI is preassigned in the package.

Funding: This work was supported by Universidad de Málaga, project PPRO-B4-2026-004 (Plan Propio de Investigación, Transferencia y Divulgación Científica).
